items.name: Group order backlog, H1 2026
items.claim: ANDRITZ group order backlog reached a record 12,602.1 MEUR as of June 30, 2026, up 20.5% versus year-end 2025.
items.source_excerpt: ANDRITZ continues strong performance in the first half of 2026 2026/07/30 Order intake rises to 5.9 billion EUR (+25.2% vs. H1 2025) Order backlog reaches a new record of 12,602.1 MEUR (+20.5% vs. year-end 2025)

notes: H1 2026 results release is a group-wide backlog figure, not specific to the tibet-mega-dam chain; no Tibet/Yarlung-specific contract disclosure found in the stored ANDRITZ documents (results release, AGM release, financial-report PDF fetch returned 0 chars). The mapping's placement evidence cites a separate 2025-05-20 hydro turbine-generator contract (Incir Group) with no stored fetch of that source.
